sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text:
Apsis Aerocom Limited; NSE SME; ISIN INE1OOJ01011. Research cutoff 2026-10-20. Dated quote ₹592.95 on 2026-10-19, not a live executable bid. Five-year nominal INR scenarios use a 15% analyst equity hurdle and ₹5 lakh illustrative position. Current scope and capital bridge are described in financial forensics and the linked model.

Gate conclusions: G 1 Integrity: Information request is not a finding; pay/control and historical lender-reporting weaknesses warrant monitoring. G 2 Reliability: Actualcash reconciles; FY 25 displayerror and capital/leaseclassifications explained, minorPATdifference notcritical. G 3 Funding: Expansion requires modelednewdebt; totalbudgetrange explicit, no assuredcredit or unpriced equity assumption. G 4 Tradability: All 60 observed;ESM-II andlotabove reference preventmechanicalexitimplementation.

Evidence confidence: financial_levels: high on current audited levels and share count; historical_cash_comparability: medium; material classification explained, exact restatement bridge incomplete; governance: medium; exchange-request outcome unobserved; valuation: medium conditional scenarios, capital-budget and funding uncertainty explicit. Forecast uncertainty is distinct from accuracy of the underlying disclosures.

Official 2026-10-19 close ₹592.95; volume 14,400.0 shares, turnover ₹8,538,480, 11.0 trades, lot 1200, series ['ST']. This dated trade is not a live executable bid. 20-session mean/median daily turnover ₹17,258,142/₹11,938,440; conservative denominator is the lower. ₹5 lakh theoretical exit takes 2.09/0.84/0.42 sessions at 2%/5%/10% participation before whole-lot rounding. 60-session mean/median daily turnover ₹13,195,487/₹8,321,940; conservative denominator is the lower. ₹5 lakh theoretical exit takes 3.00/1.20/0.60 sessions at 2%/5%/10% participation before whole-lot rounding. Not an exit guarantee: spreads, available bids, circuits, impact, settlement/surveillance and whole-lot minimum positions remain to be checked. [M1]

Official named surveillance list matches: Enhanced Surveillance Measure (ESM) - Stage II as of 20-Oct-2026. This is a trading/surveillance constraint, not a finding of misconduct. Liquidity estimates cannot assume unconstrained execution; verify applicable stage rules, circuits, settlement and live bid depth.

Official October 19 EOD indicators, effective next trading session October 21: ESM Stage II; Less than 100 unique PAN traded in previous 30 days; SME scrip is not regularly traded. These cautions do not contradict the actual observed turnover history: generic irregular-trading status is not evidence of any particular missing session. PAN breadth and expired mandatory market-making can weaken executable depth even when daily turnover is present. [REG1][REGFMT]

Current implementation assessment L 6: All 60 sessions observed.8.32194 mrupee median turnover gives 1.20 days for 5 lakh at 5%, starting 9. sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: FY 26 annual report records revenue ₹30.6452 cr, PAT ₹7.5106 cr and EPS ₹8.40 versus FY 25 ₹20.4906 cr, ₹6.6031 cr and ₹7.50. Top two customers supplied 69.62% of FY 26 sales versus 74.38% in FY 25. Concentration eased but remains large; qualification and repeat orders are not the same as pricing power. [S1]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Unimech FY 26 pre-acquisition consolidated revenue 240.4904 cr versus 242.9258 cr, with otherincome 46.9693 cr; topthreecustomers 72.37%. Shared precision qualification and concentration risks make it useful context, but aerospace tooling/assemblies, scale and subsequent acquisitions differ from Apsis machining. It does not justify copying an earnings multiple or treating all reported profit as operating manufacturing return. [PEER1]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: FY 23–26 comparable revenue 10.3700/16.8669/20.4906/30.6452 cr gives 43.50% three-year CAGR, starting 9 capped 8 for four-observation/medium economic-growth evidence. Component output 53,004→81,008→98,412 throughFY 25 and 65,727 inH 1 FY 26 supports underlying volume, though mix and unit complexity vary. FY 25 prospectusPAT 6.6376 cr differs from annual 6.6031 cr by 0.0345 cr,0.52%, not a critical reliability failure on its own. September registrar confirms 12,051,921 shares; March 8:1 bonus and 3,252,000 IPO shares reconcile denominator. Promoters 8.775 m retain 72.81%, their group 8.799921 m 73.02%. [S1][S2][CAP]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text:
FY 26 operating EBIT 10.4622 cr excluding 0.1075 cr other income;25% NOPAT 7.84665 cr divided by average equity-plus-full-debt 33.1873 cr is 23.64%. Incremental NOPAT versus prior operating EBIT 9.2636 cr is 0.89895 cr on 40.4148 cr extra accounting capital, only 2.22%, mostly late IPO cash. Neither ratio is mature UnitII return; capital budget and ramp must be tested. June management describes approximately 60 cr UnitII investment; IPOobject 27.0201 cr is machinery allocation, not established total project cost. Model carries a 60 cr conservative requirement and a 27.0201 cr alternative, not both added together. Full spent-to-date and supplier-financing bridge remains unresolved; scenario returns are conditional. [S1][S2][CALL]

Existing 150000 annualcomponentcapacity is not a uniform revenue unit because complexity varies. Prospectus UnitII table says 300000 newcomponents, while adjacent sentence ambiguously calls 300000 aggregate; annual says increaseby 300000. Do not promise 450000 verifiedfully available capacity. August 14 inauguration and six-to-ten-month machine lead times support phased, not instant, ramp. June 40.5 crbacklog and September 4.296867 cr order are separate dated observations, not automatically additive outstanding orders. Customer 1/2 shares 35.59/34.03% expose pricing and schedule risk despite qualifications. [S1][S2][CALL][UNIT][ORDER]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Historical lender-current-asset discrepancies and current disclosure errors weaken controls; RHP says no extra drawdown, benefit or covenant breach, which moderates materiality. June NSE request is not a finding. Promoter control 72.81%, FY 26 director pay 1.35 cr and related salary 0.1932 cr plus proposed 2.0562 cr director pay need monitoring; no undisclosed extraction is inferred. The April 27 and 29 disclosures are unnamed domestic orders 2.05 cr/sixmonths and 1.10 cr/twomonths, both statednon-related. April 30 board called remunerationEGM. No response/closure or adverse exchange finding was located through cutoff, so the request remains an open monitoring item, not a fraud conclusion. Current statutory/IFC opinions are unmodified; appointed internal auditor May 13 is not a replaced statutory auditor. [S1][S2][INV][ORDERAPR1][ORDERAPR2][APR][MAY] May 26 remuneration resolutions passed with 99.8% of votes cast, per scrutinizer. New pay is approved, not merely a proposal. [VOTE]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text:
FY 25 annual net-change 2.20 lakh and closing 210.34 lakh are presentation errors: CFO 4.95−investing 340.55+financing 134.22=−201.38 lakh, and opening 208.15−201.38=6.77 lakh, matching bank components and balance sheet. The difference 203.57 lakh equals printed tax paid. Thus actual cash reconciles without alleging a fictitious bank asset. FY 25 RHP CFO 163.29 lakh reflects different capital-advance/lease/restatement classifications; no falsely precise spliced conversion ratio is presented. FY 26 identifiable capital advances rise 155.39 lakh, FD 102.11 lakh and current lease liability falls 77.58 lakh inside reported operating lines. Reclassified CFO 10.3859 cr less PPE 6.4111 cr, capital advances 1.5539 cr, leaseprincipal 0.7758 cr andFD 1.0211 cr returns 0.6240 cr. The cash is not counted twice. [S1][S2][REV] The 0.7758 cr lease adjustment is an illustrative classification bridge from current-lease balances, not a verified full lease cash roll-forward; transfers/new leases can affect that balance. Core cash estimates should retain this caveat.

March 36.5051 cr cash/banks contains 2.0623 cr term deposits;34.4428 cr equivalents includes 31.222 cr unspent IPO escrow. No second IPO cash addition. Debt 4.4932 cr includes 0.3084 cr currentfinanceleases within otherCL. Payables 2.0512 cr areolderthantwo years; collectability and supplier settlement need monitoring. EPCG duty exposure 0.1614 cr relates 2.3401 cr export obligation within six years; not an overdue default. Machine capital commitments 5.0699 cr may overlap IPO contracts. Warranty clauses exist, but management records no provision after disclaiming warranty/no three-year claims; contract enforceability remains risk. Building 30 year depreciation assumes renewal of lease endingJune 2030. [S1]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text:
FY 26 financing records ₹31.1751 cr equity proceeds, not recurring cash earning power. Analyst stress: major customer schedules slip while precision machines, qualification and skilled labor remain fixed costs; advances and stock absorb funds. Monitor customer qualification renewal, rejection rates, machining utilization and outsourced content, IPO deployment and fully diluted capital. The reporting bridge is analyzed below; growth must still be financed and priced rationally. [S 1,S 2]

Bear terminal 44.01 rupees and severe 0.00; additional borrowing required 34.09/66.06 cr. IPO cash gives a buffer, but capex/customer stress can require adverse financing.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At 592.95 rupees and 1.2051921 cr shares,5 x/10 x imply 2964.75/5929.50 rupees. At 25 x terminalPAT they require 142.92/285.85 cr profits, versus 7.5106 cr current. At 25%PATmargin, revenue would need 572/1143 cr, farabove current 30.65 cr and UnitII scale discussed. Additionalplants, customers, cash and dilution would be necessary; not a supported thesis. [S1][CALL][M1]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Prioritize exchange-request resolution, order acceptance/collections, audited UnitII capital-spend/funding bridge, actual directorpay, machine installation/qualification and lease renewals. Observe margin after ramp costs and settle aged supplier balances without recurring cash strain. Strong business-demand narratives cannot make 95 x current earnings inexpensive. ESM-II and minimumlot 711540 rupees mean the 5 lakh reference cannot be implemented exactly. Conditional research is not a trade recommendation. [S1][INV][CALL][M1]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text:
Qualified precision machining with verified physical growth and UnitII inauguration, but heavy customer concentration, margin compression and uncertain total expansion funding. Cash presentation differences are substantially reconcilable; NSE information request is not an adverse finding. At the dated price, even funded growth cases offer limited valuation protection. Canonical factors and conditional IAS computed. Return conclusion remains weak under both 27.0201 cr machinery and 60 cr broader expansion interpretations; no automatic integrity hold for regulator inquiry or explained reclassification.

Final published measures: BQS 6.02; GQS 6.7; IAS 3.255. Any change in price, funded cash deployment, share count or execution restrictions requires recomputation; these are conditional research classifications, not a trade instruction.

valuation.status: Conditional operating and funding scenarios; material total-project-budget uncertainty explicitly bracketed
assumption_basis: No IPO proceeds are added to March cash again. Escrow31.222cr is already included. GCP3.9149cr and unpaid issue costs0.287cr are excluded as earmarked/potentially spent, while machinery capex is funded explicitly. Term deposits and EPCG margin deposits are excluded from surplus.

Income-tax provision0.9018cr is settled once; unidentified tax-authority assets0.873cr excluded from WC, no presumed GST/IT setoff. Full recovery is a sensitivity, not a claim. Existing current finance-lease liability0.3084cr is removed from operating payables and added to debt.

June management calls UnitII investment about60cr, while prospectus IPO machinery object is27.0201cr. We cannot verify a full total-project spent/remaining bridge. Base conservatively treats60cr as prospective requirement less known0.595cr machine advance, spread over two years. Lower-spend sensitivity uses27.0201cr less advance, not60 plus27.0201. Known5.0699cr capital commitments are included, not blindly added again.

Revenue base45/65/85/95/105cr is below management48cr FY27 and90–100cr potential FY28 scale. Bull follows faster commissioning; no UnitIII500cr aspiration is assumed. UnitII inauguration is not full installed utilization.

EBITDA32% base is below FY26 approximately37.4%; additionally subtract0.7062cr increase from actual director pay1.35cr to proposed annual2.0562cr. This explicit incremental cost is not also embedded in a separate salary line. Bear23% and bull38% show operating leverage.

Depreciation8% of opening book PPE plus cumulative gross additions, half-year convention, is a conservative proxy for machine mix, not a detailed asset roll-forward. Maintenance capex2% sales. Interest12% on opening debt,25% tax on positive PBT; new debt is required funding, not assured credit. No equity dilution is modeled because no financing terms are approved; if funding needs cannot be borrowed, returns require a new diluted model.

Base WC18% exceeds the unusually low March net ratio6.65%, partly supported by customer advances and old unpaid suppliers. Bear28%/severe35% absorb more cash. Terminal multiple15/20/25 on operating NOPAT (severe10) is a sensitivity, not a borrowed peer P/E.

Opening current claims settle once. Remaining net noncurrent legacy employee obligations are deducted from terminal equity, not assigned an invented legal maturity. Future employee service expense is assumed cash-funded through forecast operating margins; it is not added back. The terminal deduction covers only the legacy balance not otherwise paid. Accelerated settlement is a timing sensitivity, not a predicted exit schedule. FY26 note 7 and employee-benefit note: noncurrent net gratuity ₹22.24 lakh plus leave ₹6.30 lakh. Plan assets already netted; current ₹4.58 lakh is inside WC.
